name: Lightpad

hardware.note: Class-compliant USB-MIDI (and BLE MIDI). Works with the hardware; not affiliated with ROLI or Luminary. Discontinued, second-hand only.

protocol.transport: USB-MIDI (WinMM on Windows; ports are exclusive, close ROLI Connect / Dashboard)
protocol.standalone: MPE: one channel per finger, note on/off, pitch bend (x), CC74 (y), channel pressure (z)
protocol.api: BLOCKS SysEx F0 00 21 10 77 <index> <7-bit packed bits> <checksum> F7; host pings every 400 ms
protocol.leds: 15 x 15 RGB565 bitmap in the block's shared data (needs a LittleFoot renderer on hardware)

status: simulated; protocol from ROLI's reference code, not yet checked on the owner's block

sections.label: SURFACE · 15 × 15 LEDS · MULTI-TOUCH X / Y / PRESSURE
